spine.premise: James Braun — industrialist, collector, and lately a very frightened man — has gathered an unusual guest list to Braun Manor. What none of them know: Braun has spent two years assembling evidence against the Midnight Syndicate, the organization behind half the city's quiet money. Its members mark themselves with a snail. Braun hands everything to the press this week. Someone here has other plans.
spine.invitation_notes: relationship_line and motive_hook compile from the character's motive field — the letter should read warmly and land wrong. Braun inviting the person he's about to ruin is the correct energy for every letter.
spine.murder_announcement: The scream. The thud. And now, in the study where James Braun was last seen — blood caking the floor, and no sign of the body.
spine.study_scene_base: The study door stands open. Blood has soaked into the rug where he fell — a great deal of it. The desk drawer is forced and empty: whatever Braun kept, someone took. The body is gone. {method_scene_flavor}

round_intros.r2: Nobody leaves. Not with the roads like this, says the chauffeur. Not until we understand, says the detective. So: understand.
round_intros.r3: The house is quieter now. Fewer of you. The clues have not moved — unless they have.
round_intros.r4: Last hours. Whoever did this is standing in this room, holding a drink, agreeing with you.

florence.scene_flavor: On the desk, a nightcap glass — drained. There is a bitter smell to it that isn't whiskey, and a fleck of green crushed on the rim.
florence.briefing: You cut it from the far bed this evening and it went into the glass an hour later. He drank it talking to you about audits. The blood came after — he fell hard. You didn't expect so much blood. You've scrubbed your hands twice and can still smell the stem.
florence.reveal: The poison was cut from Braun's own garden — {name}, who knows every bed of it, dosed his nightcap and let gravity do the rest.

nishimoto.scene_flavor: A syringe cap lies under the desk's edge, and on Braun's blotter, a cotton ball taped down neat as a nurse's work — from a blood draw hours old, or something more recent.
nishimoto.briefing: The evening draw was real. The second visit wasn't on any chart. He trusted the needle because he always had. Your case went to the car after — clean, professional, unlabeled. You are the only person here who knows exactly how much blood a body holds, and exactly how much is on that floor.
nishimoto.reveal: The second injection was the one that mattered — {name}'s medical case went out to the car carrying more than samples.

solomon.scene_flavor: Glass everywhere — a shattered bottle, heavy, expensive. The label is soaked dark. One long shard, the neck, is missing from the wreckage.
solomon.briefing: The private case was always for him — the special reserve, hand-delivered, host's privilege. What was in it wasn't drinkable. When he tasted it and knew, the bottle became a simpler tool. The neck of it left with you, wrapped in a bar rag.
solomon.reveal: The special reserve was doctored, and when Braun tasted it, {name} finished the job with the bottle itself.

cairo.scene_flavor: Two wine glasses. One drained where he fell. The other washed, dried, and put back on the tray — by somebody with steady hands.
cairo.briefing: A peace offering: the rare vintage, the property dispute buried, neighbors again. He drank to it. You didn't — you washed your glass, dried it, set it back. The key got you into the cellar storage for the bottle; nobody counts a neighbor's steps.
cairo.reveal: The peace-offering vintage was laced — {name} shared a toast, then washed one glass and left the other.

hugo.scene_flavor: The struggle wrote itself into the room: a chair on its side, drag marks through the blood toward the window, a heel scuff on the sill.
hugo.briefing: You didn't swing anything. You made a phone call, confirmed he was in the study, and unlatched the corridor window on your way past. The men you owe sent someone who does this cleanly. Your debt is marked paid. What's on the floor in there is the interest.
hugo.reveal: {name} never touched him — he sold the location and unlatched a window, and the organization he owes sent a professional. The debt is settled.

corridor.briefing: You were in the corridor with every right to be there. Getting into the study unseen took one moment of an empty hallway — and you made that moment. Afterward, the body went out the way you know and no one else does.
corridor.reveal: in through the corridor, in plain sight, in a moment nobody can account for

window.briefing: From the dark of the lawn, the study window is a door. The latch was off. You were a shadow between the hedge and the glass, and afterward, the ground took the weight and told no one — the window took the body out as easily as it let you in.
window.reveal: through the study window, from the dark of the lawn, where the ground still holds the prints

side_path.briefing: The side path exists so that some arrivals are never seen. You've used it for the family's quiet business before. Tonight it carried you to the study's blind side, and later, it carried something out to a car that was never parked here.
side_path.reveal: around the side path, past the cars, along the route built for exactly this kind of errand

signature_beats.briefing: The snail you carry is not decoration. The order came down through you: Braun's evidence dies this week, and Braun with it. You chose the night, confirmed the guest list, and gave the nod. The other two did the work. You made it Syndicate business.
signature_beats.reveal: The order was Syndicate business, and it came through {name} — the snail they carry is a rank, not a trinket.

conviction_reveals.killer: {name} is revealed — THE SYNDICATE'S HAND. One of the three who killed James Braun.
conviction_reveals.killer_blamed: {name} is revealed — SYNDICATE ASSOCIATE. Close to it. Not the hand itself.
conviction_reveals.minion: {name} is revealed — SYNDICATE ASSOCIATE. Loyal to the snail, innocent of the blood.
conviction_reveals.guest: {name} is revealed — A GUEST OF THE HOUSE. Whatever they were hiding, it wasn't this.

endgame_reveals.town_win: The house has its answer. {killer_access} came {access_route_reveal}. {method_reveal} {signature_reveal} All three hands of the Syndicate — caught. James Braun's evidence goes to the press with three names attached.
endgame_reveals.killer_win: Three trials. Six convictions. And the Syndicate walks out the front door. {surviving_killers} pour themselves a drink from the good cabinet. Braun's evidence is ash in the study fireplace, and the snail owns another city. You dined with them all night.
endgame_reveals.jester_reveal: {name} — convicted, and delighted. Ruin was coming for them either way: {fear_line}. A cell is quieter than what was waiting outside. They wanted the blame. You gave it to them. THE DESPERATE — VICTORY.
endgame_reveals.jester_fail: {name} spent all night trying to look guilty, and you refused to oblige. THE DESPERATE — no way out after all.
endgame_reveals.braun_win: And the estate? {winner} watched {loser} convicted and disgraced, said nothing that would help, and signed the probate papers in the morning. THE BRAUN CLAIM — settled.
endgame_reveals.braun_none: The Braun claim settles in court, where it will outlive everyone in this room. Neither claimant managed it tonight.
endgame_reveals.minion_reveal: The Syndicate's associates: {names}. They carried nothing sharper than loyalty.
endgame_reveals.winners_screen: TONIGHT'S WINNERS: {winner_list}. Some of you knew you'd won an hour ago and sat on it. That's the game.
endgame_reveals.detective_result_town: working the room while the room worked them.

spine_clues.note: Neutral cards for rooms that drew no trace. Atmosphere, never evidence — they nudge people to keep talking and cannot mislead about the actual killers. The study's card renders the composed study scene instead.
generic: A tray of abandoned drinks, one glass fuller than the rest.
An ashtray that was emptied tonight, in a house where nobody admits to smoking.
A window latch left open to the dark, in a room everyone swears was never empty.

assembly_rules.cover_story_template: If pressed, you saw what {herring_name} did: {herring_seen_guilty}. Point there. Never first — always second, always reluctantly.
assembly_rules.witness_statements: For each character: for 2-3 co-located characters, seen[variant] where variant = guilty if (killer or red_herring) else innocent.
assembly_rules.note: Every {slot} fills from characters.json or the generation record. No field is written at runtime. An optional AI pass may restyle voice using the character's voice field; it may not add, remove, or alter facts.

tamper_system.insert_render_plant: Caught on the edge of the scene: {tamper_insert}.
tamper_system.scrub_render: This scene has been disturbed — someone got here first.
rules: Every tamper physically requires scanning the clue's QR — you must walk there, visibly.
A clue holds at most one tamper; a second attempt on the same clue is refused silently.
All tampering triggers the next round's 'a clue has been tampered with' announce. Scrub included.
